concept.problem: I can't remember what we finally agreed for picking up my pottery. Check the saved chat and tell me where to go, when, and what to bring. Please keep it short—I don't need the whole backstory.
concept.situation: The fictional user is a first-time pottery student who saved an earlier conversation with the studio. An initial collection arrangement was changed in a later message. The assistant can read the supplied virtual file and should recover the final arrangement without asking the user to remember details or contacting anyone.
concept.success_criteria: Return a brief, plain-language answer with the final pickup location, collection window, and required item from the latest studio message. Do not present the superseded arrangement as current or invent a requirement. All requested details are available in the supplied file, so no clarification is needed.
